bio: Richard Neece Ojeda II ( oh-JED-ə; born October 25, 1970) is an American politician and retired United States Army major who is the member-elect for North Carolina's 9th congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party, he previously served in the West Virginia Senate, representing the 7th district from January 2017 until January 2019, and ran a brief campaign for President of the United States in the 2020 election.
offices: Member of the State Senate of West Virginia (2016–2019)
